text:
Priya: quick thought — run a 2-week 'seed pulse' experiment tying webinar signups to a tiny free-credit + prompt-template pack. low risk, should surface early activation signals.
Tom: sounds promising. what's the target cohort? new signups only or trial users too?
Priya: new signups first. keep it narrow: first 7 days after signup, geo US/EU.
Sam: outbound routing question — should we route these leads into the webinar nurture flow or a separate 'seed pulse' track?
Jules: separate track so we can A/B the copy and landing. also lets product see signal without contaminating the main funnel.
Maya: i'll own the prompt pack. thinking 3 templates: cold-start prompt, summarization quickwin, and a tiny demo prompt for embeddings.
Marco: credit size? suggest $5 equivalent — enough to run a few prompts but not open-ended.
Rachel: copy angle: "Try Redwood with a guided template pack — get $5 to experiment". short, clear CTA to register for the webinar or claim the pack.
Priya: Ops question: need inbound routing flags so sales sees high-intent registrants vs seed-pack claimers. ops-bot can we add a tag?
ops-bot: quick status — feature-flag prepped. use flag: seed_pulse_v1. webhook payload will include "seed_pulse=true".
Sam: mapping for routing: if seed_pulse=true AND registered_for_webinar=true => route to webinar nurture; else if seed_pulse=true AND claimed_pack=true => route to seed-engage channel.
Priya: here's the minimal config snippet for the product team to wire up:```json
{
  "experiment": "seed_pulse_v1",
  "credit_amount": 5,
  "templates": ["cold_start_v1","summary_quickwin_v1","embed_demo_v1"],
  "cohort": "new_signup_7d_us_eu"
}
```
Tom: timeline? we can implement flags + crediting in 3 days, landing + copy in 2. recommend go-live next Thursday.
Maya: I'll have template drafts by Wednesday.
Rachel: i'll draft landing + email copy by Wednesday EOD. will include one variant that teases webinar benefits and one purely product-first variant.
Marco: how will we measure success? activation rate (used credit + returned in 7d), webinar signups uplift, and avg tokens used per user.
Priya: yes — primary metric: 7-day activation (any successful generation after claiming). secondary: webinar conversion and retention at 14 days.
Jules: let's add an evaluation prompt set so we can catch quality regressions tied to templates. small eval harness of 10 prompts.
Priya: all right — owners: Maya (templates), Rachel (copy + landing), Tom (routing + infra), Marco (metrics), Jules (evals), Sam (sales routing). I'll coordinate kickoff in #marketing-ops. :rocket:
Sam: added kickoff on calendar for Tue 10am.
ops-bot: reminder created: feature flag rollout window Tue 10:00-11:00.
Priya: perfect — thanks team. we'll iterate on the first cohort and reconvene after 1 week of data. :eyes:
